name: image-template-store-screenshot-gameplay-moment
title: Store Screenshot - Staged Gameplay Moment

title_i18n.zh-CN: 商店截图 - 精心摆拍的游戏瞬间

description: A staged 16:9 in-game screenshot for a store page or press kit that sells one specific moment of play: the player in focus, a clear threat and answer, a minimal readable HUD and a hint of progression, composed to survive the small store carousel thumbnail.

description_i18n.en: A staged 16:9 in-game screenshot for a store page or press kit that sells one specific moment of play: the player in focus, a clear threat and answer, a minimal readable HUD and a hint of progression, composed to survive the small store carousel thumbnail.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 为商店页或媒体资料包生成一张 16:9 的摆拍游戏截图，突出一个具体的游玩瞬间：玩家角色清晰、威胁与应对一目了然、HUD 简洁可读并带有成长暗示，构图在商店轮播小缩略图中依然清楚。

query.en:
A staged in-game screenshot for a store page, 1920x1080, that sells one specific moment of play. It must look like a real frame captured from the running game, not concept art or a poster.

Game: {argument name="game_pitch" default="a top-down twin-stick shooter set in an overgrown solar-punk greenhouse station"}.
Visual style: {argument name="art_style" default="clean pixel art at 480x270 native resolution, scaled up with crisp nearest-neighbour pixels"}.
Moment to show: {argument name="moment" default="the player dashing through a ring of enemy bullets while a charged laser clears a corridor of vine creatures"}.

# Composition
- Player character slightly off-centre on a rule-of-thirds point, facing into open space, never hidden behind UI or effects.
- One action that reads left to right: the threat and the player's answer are both obvious within a second.
- Foreground, playfield and background separated by value; the playfield carries the highest contrast.
- One hint of depth or progression: {argument name="progression_hint" default="an upgrade pickup glowing just ahead and a sealed door in the background"}.

# HUD
- Minimal HUD in the same art style: health top-left, ability cooldowns bottom-centre, currency or score top-right.
- Keep every HUD element inside a 5% safe margin, centre of the frame clear. Numbers crisp and plausible, one consistent UI font.

# Readability
- Must read at 600x338, the store carousel size: strong silhouettes, high contrast between player, enemies and floor, effects bright but never covering the player.
- Palette: {argument name="palette" default="lush greens and warm sunlight, with magenta enemy bullets for maximum contrast"}.
- Consistent pixel size everywhere; light comes from one direction.

# Avoid
Smeared or mixed-resolution pixels, painterly concept-art rendering, lens flares hiding gameplay, controller button prompts, store badges, review quotes, real brand logos, watermarks, and any text outside the HUD.
